    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r, c in pts)
    core = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    cp = [(r, c) for r, c in pts if grid[r][c] == core]
    cr0, cr1 = min(r for r, c in cp), max(r for r, c in cp)
    cc0, cc1 = min(c for r, c in cp), max(c for r, c in cp)
    ch, cw = cr1-cr0+1, cc1-cc0+1
    # Learned expansion: the marked inner rectangle sets the outward halo;
    # for unequal dimensions use the rounded-up half of the smaller side.
    t = ch if ch == cw else (min(ch, cw)+1)//2
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0, r0-t), min(h, r1+t+1)):
        for c in range(max(0, c0-t), min(w, c1+t+1)):
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = core
    return out
